name: Mansueto fort (Valdecebro)
story: Mansueto is a promontory guarding the south-eastern approach to Teruel above Valdecebro. The Republicans fortified it not with the usual sandbagged trenches but with a small fort of thick concrete and brick walls, roofed with a concrete slab on railway rails. It formed part of the Republican ring around Teruel.
see: Broken wall sections with firing loopholes and fragments of the concrete roof.
plan: It is a short walk from Valdecebro, about 5 km east of Teruel. The site is ruined, so watch your footing.
